claim: Patchline flags a migration that drops an index a hot query still needs, so a schema change cannot silently turn an indexed lookup into a sequential scan in production. The worker models each hot query by the columns it filters on and each index by the columns it covers, then for a proposed DROP INDEX checks whether every hot query retains at least one covering index after the drop. The gate proves dropping an index that uniquely covers a hot login query is blocked while dropping an unused scratch index is allowed.
